title: Design System: Zoid 666 Sumi-Ink Command System

display.purpose: Daily purpose and main objective only.

motion.name: row
motion.purpose: Ledger row insertion and state update.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single primary action on a decision surface.
components.css: .ds-primary { height: 44px; border: 1px solid #0D0A0A; border-radius: 0; padding: 0 14px; background: #0D0A0A; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: Georgia, serif; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .14em; } .ds-primary:hover { border-color: #C23A2E; background: #C23A2E; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C23A2E; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.css: .ds-quiet { height: 30px; border: 1px solid #E0E0E0; border-radius: 0; padding: 0 10px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #0D0A0A; font-family: Georgia, serif; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .12em; } .ds-quiet:hover { border-color: #0D0A0A; } .ds-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C23A2E; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Neutral Field
components.description: Square paper field with ink focus.
components.css: .ds-field { min-height: 42px; border: 1px solid #E0E0E0; border-radius: 0; padding: 10px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #0D0A0A; font: 14px/1.5 Georgia, serif; } .ds-field:focus { border-color: #0D0A0A; outline: 2px solid #C23A2E; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Health Status
components.description: Written health state using ink, seal, or okay fill.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-block; border: 1px solid #C23A2E; border-radius: 0; padding: 4px 7px; background: #C23A2E; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: Georgia, serif; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: .14em; }

components.name: Health Ledger Row
components.description: Ruled source health row for Release 0 diagnostics.
components.css: .ds-health { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto auto; gap: 16px; align-items: center; border-top: 1px solid #EDEDED; border-bottom: 1px solid #EDEDED; padding: 14px 0; color: #0D0A0A; font-family: Georgia, serif; } .ds-health span { padding: 4px 7px; background: #2F3A2F; color: #FFFFFF; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: .12em; } .ds-health small { color: #545554; }

narrative.overview: White paper, black ink, pale rules, and a single red seal create a quiet operational workspace for daily behavioral coaching.

rules.name: The One Seal Rule
rules.body: Red seal is the only saturated accent and remains rare enough to signal a decision.

rules.name: The Flat Ledger Rule
rules.body: Surfaces remain flat and ruled, with no decorative shadow stacks.

dos: Do place the active task and next action before analytics.
Do make missing data visually different from zero.
donts: Don't use blue architecture, decorative gradients, glassmorphism, warm gold, neon accents, or novelty AI styling.
Don't use shame, guilt, disappointment, or moral labels in coaching copy.
